ops.body:
- **G? [M] Explore in Navigate: a sheet over the walk's own map, the first slice of three** (2026-11-22) · Earn · aligned if reshaped
  Area: walk-screen, explore, tabs. From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-22). Brief: docs/research/explore-in-navigate.md.
  Calls: Explore moves into Navigate as a sheet over the walk's own map, ready and walking alike, holding all of Explore; the Explore tab goes (Chronicle · Navigate), last, once the sheet holds everything; with the sheet up the map pans freely and the row steps by its own swipe (amends 0124's swipe on the map); an ink "Explore" pill at the top right, two heights, the captures riding above the sheet and floating over a full card, as drawn. Decision 0258.
  Mock-up: https://claude.ai/artifact/BYDBWTYdQdvDimi8LLQ8gv (docs/mockups/explore-in-navigate/), approved "Approve as drawn (Recommended)" (2026-11-22).
  Done when: on a walk in progress, at 390 px, the owner can see the areas around them, open one and set it as where the walk goes, without minimizing the walk or leaving the walk screen; the walk's trace, the walker and the capture stack stay in view the whole time.
  Touches: VISION.md Always, "Capture is one tap away on every screen you walk or capture from" and "Restraint"; Never, "Tallies … No counts on Explore (NV14)", "A card or screen that lists what is left to find", "Nagging"; decisions 0076 (one screen), 0112 (the tabs), 0124 (amended by 0258), 0121, NV4, NV10.
  The slice: 1. The walk screen, ready and walking, shows an ink "Explore" pill at the top right (44 pt, the compass glyph, `aria-expanded`); a tap raises the sheet, a second tap, a pull down, Back and Escape lower it; nothing raises it by itself. 2. Raised, the sheet holds "Near you" and the row of area cards in Explore's order (`rowOf`), the selected card outlined, as drawn; the strip below it is unchanged (Start, or the walk's numbers and Pause). 3. The walk's map draws the selected area's ring (a town: its border) and names only it; the walker, the trace and any route stay drawn; one live map, no second canvas (NV4). 4. Selecting a card, by a tap or the row's own swipe, eases the walk map to that area; one finger on the map pans it (0258); lowered, the camera follows again (walking) or returns to where it was (ready). 5. At the row's height the capture stack and Layers ride above the sheet's top edge; with an area's card at full height the camera, mic and note float at the right edge over it; each is one tap at every height. 6. A tap on the selected card opens the area's card at full height in the sheet; Walk to sets the destination on the ready screen without leaving it, or routes the open walk (NV10); a far Walk to asks as today (0121); Open in Maps as today. 7. The sheet shows no count of places, areas or finds, never names an unfound place, and lists no places left to find (AT7, NV14). 8. At 320 px nothing in the sheet, the pill or the strip is cut or overlaps (the drawn 320 board). 9. A journey for the sheet, ready and walking, pictures each state at 390 and 320; the Explore tab is unchanged in this slice. 10. The sheet's pull and the riding stack on MapLibre RN are recorded in `docs/NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.md`.
  Precedent: Apple Maps' search card over its one map (Find Nearby, swipe up for all, Search Here; verified); Google Maps' Explore as a sheet over the same map (unverified); AllTrails keeps Explore and Navigate as separate tabs, the split this leaves (unverified). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Browse what is near from the map you walk on".
  Payoff: every walk; Explore is reached without minimizing the walk, and Walk to stops jumping screens. Cost: M by criteria, heavy by files: Explore's inline state lifted out of `(tabs)/explore.tsx` into a hook, a new `components/walk/ExploreSheet.tsx`, `walk.tsx`, `useReady.tsx`, `components/walk/layout.ts` (the riding stack), `AtlasCarousel`, `AtlasCard` (no `hideTabs` inside the sheet), `WalkMap`'s area props; about ten source files; native sheet code (unverified). Reopens: walk-screen, explore, tabs. After it: slice 2, town pages, search, Plan an outing and the walk planner from the sheet; slice 3, the Explore tab removed (two tabs, `/explore` to the walk screen with the sheet up, journeys moved off `tab-explore`, launch's tab check).
  Instead: the pill opening today's Explore whole over the walk screen, its own map with the walk's taken down (criteria 1, 7, 9).
